notes.note: Speakers verified against 0724.bla (MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N shows entry N+1; slice labels match). #0.48 is the last (15th) slot of the leader block #0.34-48 from story_156; first Pt_Chara_Check chain 12,14,15,13,11,2,3,4,5,1,7,8,9,10,6 = Seven, Mebius, Zero, Taro, Ultraman, RX, Momotaros, W, OOO, Rider 1, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, so this is Nu Gundam.
King Pandon roar, extended from the established 'Kih!! Kih!! Kiiiiiiih!!'.
Ankh, reacting to the powered-up King Pandon ('koitsu' = the monster).
King Pandon's death cry as it explodes (script: explosion SE, fade).

Leader block #0.56-70 uses the second Pt_Chara_Check chain 5,4,3,2,1,15,14,13,12,11,10,9,8,7,6 = OOO, W, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Nu. Wording confirms (#0.58 Momotaros drawl, #0.61 Zero 'yagaru', #0.62 Mebius polite). Subject 'the clouds' carried by 'too' = in addition to the light from the pillar.
Seravee's Voice. 'Shinshoku' of Veda rendered 'erosion of Veda' (no earlier English; later slices 160/166/168 use the same word, keep consistent).
0725: narration (no CharaNameIn), likely shown when the player inspects the pillar; Ankh's follow-up is entry 0.3, not in this slice.

0726 leader blocks #0.2-16, #0.18-32, #0.37-51, #0.53-67 use the chain 11-15,1-10 = Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, RX, Momotaros, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. Wording confirms (#0.5 and #0.40 polite Mebius, #0.6/#0.9 rough Zero/Momotaros). 'Denser' = the Minus Energy Ankh mentions in #0.1.
Script never calls this entry (party block ends at +31, next call +33 = #0.34 narration). Content and the following narration point to Ankh; voiced as Ankh. Apparently unused text.
Ankh, hit by Zetton's attack (Zetton fireball SE in script).
#0.53-55 = Ultraman, Seven, Taro; block continues in story_158. Reaction to Zetton's attack.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers checked against 0724/0725/0726.bla; extractor labels correct here. #0726 #0.33 is not referenced by the script (treated as Ankh). 'Erosion of Veda' is a new rendering. No new names.
